loadout.name: lunge slash
counterplay: The caster dashes straight at the aim during a short windup; sidestep the line.
Shield the slash, or hit the caster to cancel the dash.
loadout.balanceReason: Swipe-sized slash that closes 90 px at the cost of a committed windup.

loadout.name: pepper stream
counterplay: Shield or dash through the attack.
Move outside the marked damage area.
loadout.balanceReason: Bounded geometry, readable warnings and finite resources.

loadout.name: spinning sweep
counterplay: The spin covers every side but reaches only 56 px; stay out of reach.
Its long recovery leaves the caster open afterwards.
loadout.balanceReason: All-round reach and knockback in exchange for lower damage and recovery.

loadout.name: homing missile
counterplay: The missile turns gradually toward a nearby enemy; sidestep or dash past it.
Destroy it, shield its impact or put solid cover between you and its flight path.
loadout.balanceReason: One destructible guided projectile with a bounded turn rate, acquisition radius, speed and lifetime.

loadout.name: spear thrust
counterplay: The spear reaches far along one narrow line; step to the side.
Shield the tip or close inside its reach.
loadout.balanceReason: Longer, narrower reach than the swipe on a similar cadence.

loadout.name: bouncing laser
counterplay: The complete reflected path is marked before the beam fires.
Dash across the short pulse or use a shield; the ray reflects at most twice.
loadout.balanceReason: A narrow, short-lived reflected ray with a fixed total travel budget and visible warning.
